title: Isolated queen's pawn

D0.outcome: Names the isolated queen's pawn and lists its strengths (space, supported outposts, attacking chances) and its weaknesses (needs protection in the ending; the square in front).

D1.outcome: States the plan for each side in a typical IQP position: pieces on and attack, or pieces off and win the pawn.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, chooses to trade or keep pieces from the right side of the structure and places pieces to blockade or to attack.

D3.outcome: Predicts how piece trades change the verdict and notes the reflex weakness on the queenside.

misconceptions: The isolani is a plain weakness (or a plain strength).
conditions: The owner has pieces on and a kingside target; the opponent's pieces are not yet traded.
Build solidly first; attack only when the enemy has withdrawn kingside pieces.
contrasts: Pieces are traded, so the endgame weakness shows.
Treating the isolani as dead weight when engines rate many such positions about equal.
No isolated pawn in the position.

soft_prereq_notes.POS.BLOCKADE.D2: blockading the isolani is the central plan against it
